cause: After turning left and pausing for nearly four seconds facing a low white concrete barrier and a large cone marked '3', the robot accelerated straight forward at 7.625 s and collided head-on with the barrier at 9.000 s. The IMU log does not match the video timeline (showing motion and a 0.95 g lateral spike at 7.02 s while the video shows the robot completely stationary), so the video is trusted.
evidence: 00:00.000-00:03.750: Robot executes a left turn on dry concrete tiles in low-light nighttime conditions, coming to face a white barrier and cone '3' roughly 1.2 m ahead.

00:03.750-00:07.500: Robot remains completely stationary in the video; however, the IMU log reports stillness from t=1.86 s to 5.16 s and strong acceleration spikes at t=7.02 s (ay_g=-0.945, ax_g=0.613), indicating the IMU log is desynchronized or mismatched.
00:07.625-00:09.000: Robot drives straight forward ~1.2 m over 1.375 s (~0.9 m/s) directly into the white barrier next to cone '3'.
00:09.000-00:10.500: Front of the robot impacts and presses against the barrier before reversing slightly at 00:10.625-00:11.250.

other_factors: IMU log is desynchronized or mismatched relative to video frames

unknowns: Exact time offset or source of mismatch between the IMU log and the video frames
Exact distance and speed without calibrated wheel odometry
